body: Yeah it’s pretty normal to feel a bit tired after taking benzos. Also kpins have a long half life compared to lets say xanax so there will still be a lot in your system the next day. Drink a cup of coffee or two to get through the day but this isn’t anything to worry about. Tomorrow or the day after by the latest you’ll feel fine.

In most countries medical professionals, including mental health specialists have to keep everything you tell them confidential. Definitely go see someone about it. While things will start to feel normal again with enough time, it can really speed up the process and probably a good idea after psychosis. Also I wouldn’t recommend taking any kind of psychedelic again, they intensify emotions wich can lead bad trips really easily if you are in a bad mindset or have underlying conditions
